title.narrative: UNICEF advanced high-level advocacy to promote diversion and expand alternatives to deprivation of liberty, while institutionalizing capacity-building on child-friendly, gender-sensitive justice and protection from violence, reaching over 14,700 professionals across the justice, education, social protection and law enforcement sectors. Legislative and service reforms, including free child-friendly legal aid, remained priorities.
